title: Shawarma-Style Lamb Koftas with Indian Spices
description: A fusion of middle eastern and Indian flavors, these lamb koftas are marinated in a mix of spices and yogurt, then grilled to perfection. Serve with naan or rice for a delicious and authentic meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, ginger, garlic, garam masala, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb to the bowl and mix until just combined. Do not overmix.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each kofta.
Grill the koftas for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and lightly charred.
Serve the koftas hot with naan or rice and your favorite toppings.
